discovery: The theory of cosmic inflation and the quantum origin of cosmic structure
motivation: Guth proposed that an early epoch of exponential expansion solves the horizon, flatness and monopole problems. Linde's new and chaotic inflation made the idea workable and turned it into a general framework. Mukhanov (with Chibisov) showed that quantum vacuum fluctuations stretched during inflation seed the density perturbations that grew into galaxies, predicting a nearly scale-invariant, adiabatic, Gaussian spectrum with a slight red tilt. COBE, WMAP and Planck have since confirmed these predictions with high precision, including the measured spectral index n_s of about 0.965 and spatial flatness. Inflation links quantum field theory in curved spacetime to the largest structures we observe. It is now the standard paradigm for initial conditions in cosmology and a central meeting point between quantum gravity and observation. It has shaped four decades of theoretical and observational cosmology, and upcoming B-mode searches keep testing it.
